correctness.rationale: Direct functional-selection equivalence is proved in RESULT.md for every finite team. Unmixed fibres can be ignored; each mixed fibre demands at least one of only three input selectors, so every minimal failure uses at most four mixed fibres, and four fibres force exactly eight rows. The remaining finite set of 49 state vectors per fibre is enumerated exhaustively by verify.py over 292824 canonical configurations for one to four fibres; all one-row deletions are tested. The exact size spectrum {4,6,7,8}, normalized counts 306, and explicit eight-row witness are checked from the actual embedded Python algorithm; 400 independently implemented direct-split comparisons guard the normal-form computation. The reduction, not the sample, extends this certificate to all finite intermediate alphabets.

value.rationale: The chained dependency split is a natural database integrity and team-semantics constraint known to be incoherent without alphabet restrictions. The first determinant enlargement from two to three values while fixing a Boolean output has a new sharp constant (8 rather than 6), admits a seven-row minimal obstruction but no five-row obstruction, and has 306 canonical forbidden patterns. This determines the precise size of local counterexample certificates and gives a complete natural obstruction classification with potential finite-domain validation use.
